result.reason: The clause appropriately converts the no-hire into a mutual non-solicit, limits it to personnel directly involved in the services, and includes general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs. However, it applies through one year after the Agreement ends rather than for 12 months after each person's involvement ends, so it may restrict solicitation for longer than the fallback permits. The margin comment overstates compliance with the playbook.
